items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Sinks After Q4 Loss, Is The Stock A Bargain?
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) is back in focus after its latest quarterly and full year 2026 earnings, where revenue reached US$3.41b for Q4 but the company reported a net loss of US$282m. The recent Q4 results and guidance sparked a sharp pullback, with Palo Alto Networks’ 7 day share price return down 13.3% and its 30 day share price return down 9.4%.
